mechanism: Moxifloxacin inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, reducing colchicine metabolism and clearance, leading to increased colchicine accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor closely for colchicine toxicity signs (GI symptoms, myopathy, neuropathy); consider colchicine dose reduction or alternative antibiotic if possible, especially in renal/hepatic impairment.
